_comment: Transcribed from an in-game screenshot taken 2026-08-01 (Steam capture index 86 in the 16:03 run), SELECT MELEE WEAPON. Melee has no CUSTOMIZE screen, so the art is cropped from the same shot. Melee reports Hit Delay and Damage instead of the primary-weapon stat block, and has no trait chips.
name: Hunting Knife

description.text: A personal knife carried by SSG Simone "Gecko" Espina. Designed for fast attacks, striking enemies from the back or while they are prone will initiate a lethal takedown. Increases sprint speed when equipped.
